Getting paid

AutoStacc's fee, the 14-day hold, setting up your payout account with Stripe, and requesting a payout.

On this page

  1. What you earn
  2. Setting up payouts
  3. Requesting a payout

Last updated October 16, 2026

Your earnings and payouts are in the Studio. Only a creator's owner sees them: team members never see money.

What you earn

AutoStacc keeps 20% of each sale (after any promo code) and you get the rest, fixed when the order is placed. Each sale is held for 14 days, the time buyers have to refund, and then becomes available.

Setting up payouts

  1. In the Studio's earnings, pick the country of your bank account and choose Set up payouts.
  2. Stripe asks for your ID, tax and bank details on its own page. AutoStacc never sees them.
  3. When Stripe is done, the Studio shows your payout account as ready.

Payout accounts can be in the United States, the United Kingdom, the European Economic Area, Canada or Switzerland.

Requesting a payout

Once at least $10 is available, choose Request a payout. You can have one open request at a time; AutoStacc sends it and it shows as paid.

If a sale is refunded after you were paid for it, the amount comes out of your next sales before anything more is available.
